items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including a template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Template Engine Injection Vulnerability (BlockStrap)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code through a template engine injection.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including several stored cross-site scripting and incorrect authorization flaws. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability, codenamed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by injecting malicious PHP code through the template engine's `styles` property and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after public disclosure.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability allowing an authenticated attacker with low privileges to inject malicious JavaScript, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution in the victim's browser.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (RCE)
items.summary: This critical remote code execution vulnerability is caused by unrestricted file upload with dangerous types, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code. It has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output (RCE)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to trigger arbitrary code execution over the network against exposed Adobe Commerce and Magento storefronts due to improper encoding or escaping of output.
